1	# GUI Frontend
     2	
     3	The frontend is a vanilla JavaScript SPA with no build step, served as static files by the built-in HTTP server from `gui/public/`.
     4	
     5	## Architecture
     6	
     7	- **Routing:** Hash-based client-side router (`#/path`) with named parameter extraction (`:id`, `:wid`).
     8	- **Module system:** Native ES modules loaded by the browser. No bundler.
     9	- **State management:** None — every view fetches fresh data from the REST API on render. Mutations trigger a full view re-render.
    10	- **Styling:** Pico CSS (classless variant) as base layer, with a custom `styles.css` override layer using CSS custom properties. Light/dark theme switching via `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`.
    11	
    12	## Router
    13	
    14	The `Router` class (`gui/public/js/router.js`) manages view lifecycle:
    15	
    16	1. Listens for `hashchange` events.
    17	2. Matches the hash against registered patterns.
    18	3. Calls the previous view's cleanup function (if returned).
    19	4. Clears the `#app` container.
    20	5. Calls the matched view function with `(container, params)`.
    21	6. Stores any cleanup function returned by the view.
    22	
    23	## Routes
    24	
    25	| Hash Pattern | View | Description |
    26	|---|---|---|
    27	| `#/` | `dashboard.js` | Project listing with creation form. |
    28	| `#/repositories` | `repositories.js` | Repository CRUD table. Each row's **Name** column renders as a clickable `<a class="repo-name-display repo-name-link">` element linking to `#/repositories/${encodeURIComponent(repo.id)}`. Clicking Edit switches the Name cell to an inline `<input>` for in-place editing; Save/Cancel restore the link with updated or original text. |
    29	| `#/repositories/:id` | `repository-detail.js` | Repository overview: table of every workspace across every project that contains the given repository. Each row shows Project (link to `#/projects/:pid`), Workspace (link to `#/projects/:pid/workspaces/:wid`), and the shared Branch/Status/Actions cells from `buildRepoStatusCells`. STABLE workspace rows show plain-text branch names; all other rows have a clickable branch-switch trigger. A "Refresh" button re-fetches all status data and updates rows in-place via `doRefresh()` (protected by a `refreshInProgress` mutex). An empty-state message is shown when no projects contain the repository. Individual project/workspace fetch failures are handled gracefully via `Promise.allSettled` — partial results are displayed and a warning toast is shown when any fetch failed. The webserver URL is fetched once during initial load; the "Browse" button is shown only when `webserverUrl` is configured. |
    30	| `#/projects/:id` | `project-detail.js` | Project metadata, tabbed repo/workspace/danger-zone management. The workspace table includes a **Health** column: initialized workspaces with health issues show a warning badge with issue count; healthy and uninitialized workspaces show an empty cell. Health is fetched in parallel with status for all initialized workspaces via `Promise.allSettled` (graceful degradation — fetch failures leave the health cell empty). |
    31	| `#/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid` | `workspace-detail.js` | Live git status with countdown-based polling and manual refresh. Health report fetched in parallel on initial load and on every poll/refresh cycle. Unhealthy workspaces render a `.health-alert` card with per-issue rows and fix buttons (`Regenerate File` for `regenerate-workspace-file` issues, `Fix Setup` for `setup-workspace` issues). The header management row includes an **"Open in VS Code"** button (shown only when `workspace.initialized` is `true`; dynamically inserted after a successful Setup without a full re-render). The repository status table has a 4th **"Actions"** column; each repository row contains a **"Browse"** button (shown only when `webserverUrl` is configured, opens `{webserverUrl}/{projectId}/{workspaceId}/{repoId}/` in a new tab via `window.open`) followed by a **"Git GUI"** button that calls `api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop()`. The webserver URL is fetched once during the initial data load (in parallel with other requests) via `api.config.webserverUrl.get()`. In non-STABLE workspaces, each **Branch** cell is a clickable trigger (`<button class="branch-switch-trigger">`) that opens an inline quick-switch popover via `showBranchQuickSwitch()`. STABLE workspace branch cells remain plain text. |
    32	| `#/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branch-switch` | `branch-switch.js` | 3-step branch switch wizard. |
    33	| `#/settings` | `settings.js` | Settings view with three sections: **Git Credentials** (add/delete per-host PATs), **Repositories Refresh Delay** (configurable `gitPollingIntervalSeconds`), and **Webserver URL** (base URL of the local webserver; enables the "Browse" button in the workspace-detail view). All non-credentials sections share a single **"Save Settings"** footer button that calls each section's `save()` function in parallel. |
    34	| `#/error-log` | `error-log.js` | Paginated, filterable error log table with expandable detail rows and "Clear All" action. |
    35	
    36	## API Client
    37	
    38	`api.js` exports a namespaced `api` object with six groups:
    39	
    40	- `api.repositories` — `list()`, `get(id)`, `create(data)`, `update(id, data)`, `delete(id)`
    41	- `api.projects` — `list()`, `get(id)`, `create(data)`, `update(id, data)`, `rename(id, newId)`, `delete(id)`, `addRepository(pid, rid)`, `removeRepository(pid, rid)`
    42	- `api.workspaces` — `list(pid)`, `get(pid, wid)`, `create(pid, data)`, `update(pid, wid, data)`, `rename(pid, wid, newId)`, `delete(pid, wid)`, `setup(pid, wid)`, `health(pid, wid)`, `regenerateFile(pid, wid)`, `launch.vscode(pid, wid)`, `launch.githubDesktop(pid, wid, rid)`
    43	- `api.branches` — `list(pid, wid)`, `switch(pid, wid, assignments)`
    44	- `api.status` — `get(pid, wid)`, `refresh(pid, wid)`
    45	- `api.config.credentials` — `list()`, `set(data)`, `delete(host)`
    46	- `api.config.polling` — `get()`, `set(seconds)`
    47	- `api.config.webserverUrl` — `get()`, `set(url)`
    48	- `api.errorLog` — `list(params?)`, `get(id)`, `clear()`, `count()`
    49	
    50	### `api.workspaces` — Health & File Methods
    51	
    52	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    53	|---|---|---|
    54	| `health(pid, wid)` | `GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/health` | Fetch the health report for an initialized workspace. Returns `{ healthy: boolean, issues: Array<{ type: string, severity: string, message: string, fixAction: string, repositoryId?: string }> }`. |
    55	| `regenerateFile(pid, wid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/regenerate-workspace-file` | Regenerate the `.code-workspace` file from the current repository list without cloning. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. |
    56	
    57	**`health()` issue `fixAction` values:**
    58	- `regenerate-workspace-file` — missing or stale `.code-workspace` file; surface a `Regenerate File` button.
    59	- `setup-workspace` — uncloned repository; surface a `Fix Setup` button.
    60	
    61	### `api.workspaces.launch` — External-App Launch Methods
    62	
    63	External-application launchers are grouped under the `api.workspaces.launch` sub-namespace. New launcher methods (e.g. "Open in Terminal") should be added here rather than as flat methods on `api.workspaces`.
    64	
    65	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    66	|---|---|---|
    67	| `launch.vscode(pid, wid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/vscode` | Open the workspace's `.code-workspace` file in VS Code. No request body. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. 400 if the workspace file does not exist on disk (run setup first). 500 on OS-level spawn failure (logged under Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-vscode'`). |
    68	| `launch.githubDesktop(pid, wid, rid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/github-desktop/:rid` | Open a repository's local clone directory in GitHub Desktop. No request body. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. 400 if the repository directory does not exist on disk (run setup first). 500 on OS-level spawn failure (logged under Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-github-desktop'`). |
    69	
    70	**Caller contract:** All path parameters (`pid`, `wid`, `rid`) are passed through `encodeURIComponent` inside `api.js`. Callers are responsible for validating that these values are not `undefined`/`null` before invoking these methods — `encodeURIComponent` will coerce them to the strings `'undefined'`/`'null'` rather than throwing.
    71	
    72	### `api.errorLog` Reference
    73	
    74	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    75	|---|---|---|
    76	| `list(params?)` | `GET /api/error-log[?...]` | Fetch error log entries with optional filtering and pagination. |
    77	| `get(id)` | `GET /api/error-log/:id` | Fetch a single entry by numeric ID. |
    78	| `clear()` | `DELETE /api/error-log` | Delete all entries. Resolves with `undefined` on HTTP 204. |
    79	| `count()` | `GET /api/error-log?limit=0` | Fetch only the total count (no entries payload). Useful for badges. |
    80	
    81	**`list()` params shape:**
    82	
    83	```js
    84	api.errorLog.list({
    85	    severity: 'error',   // optional — 'error' | 'warning'
    86	    source:   'clone',   // optional — exact-match on Source field
    87	    limit:    10,        // optional — max entries to return (default 100 server-side)
    88	    offset:   0,         // optional — zero-based page offset
    89	})
    90	```
    91	
    92	All params are optional. Omitting `params` entirely (or passing `undefined`) sends a bare `GET /api/error-log`.
    93	
    94	**`clear()` 204 contract:** The underlying `request()` helper resolves with `undefined` when the server returns HTTP 204 (no body). Callers should not try to read a response value from `clear()`.
    95	
    96	**`count()` pattern:** Sends `GET /api/error-log?limit=0`. The server returns `{ entries: [], total: N }`. Read `response.total` for the count. This is the recommended approach for polling a badge counter without transferring entry data.
    97	
    98	### `api.config.polling` Reference
    99	
   100	| Method | HTTP | Description |

1	/**
     2	 * Repo Status Cells Component — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Encapsulates the reusable Branch, Status badge, and Actions `<td>` cell-building
     5	 * logic shared between the workspace-detail and repository-detail views.
     6	 *
     7	 * ## Exported functions
     8	 *
     9	 * - `buildRepoStatusCells`   — Build the three `<td>` elements for a single
    10	 *   repository row (branch, badge, actions). Callers assemble the full `<tr>`.
    11	 * - `makeBranchTrigger`      — Build a `<button class="branch-switch-trigger">`.
    12	 * - `updateRepoStatusCells`  — Update branch and badge cells in-place within a
    13	 *   `<tr>`, locating them by CSS class (`.repo-branch-cell`,
    14	 *   `div[data-repo-id]`) rather than by hardcoded cell indices. The
    15	 *   branch-trigger aria-label is sourced from `row.dataset.repoName`
    16	 *   when present, falling back to `repoId` when the attribute is absent.
    17	 *
    18	 * @module repo-status-cells
    19	 */
    20	
    21	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    22	import { createStatusBadge } from './status-badge.js';
    23	
    24	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    25	// Public exports
    26	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27	
    28	/**
    29	 * Build a branch-switch trigger `<button>` styled as inline text.
    30	 *
    31	 * Extracted to avoid duplicating the element setup in both `buildRepoStatusCells`
    32	 * (initial render) and `updateRepoStatusCells` (polling updates). The click
    33	 * handler is wired by the caller so it can close over a fresh `trigger`
    34	 * reference.
    35	 *
    36	 * @param {string} branchName - Branch name shown as the button label.
    37	 * @param {string} ariaLabel  - Accessible label for screen-readers.
    38	 * @returns {HTMLButtonElement}
    39	 */
    40	export function makeBranchTrigger(branchName, ariaLabel) {
    41	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    42	    btn.type        = 'button';
    43	    btn.className   = 'branch-switch-trigger';
    44	    btn.textContent = branchName;
    45	    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', ariaLabel);
    46	    return btn;
    47	}
    48	
    49	/**
    50	 * Build the three shared status `<td>` cells for a single repository row.
    51	 *
    52	 * Returns a plain object with `branchCell`, `badgeCell`, and `actionsCell`
    53	 * so the caller can insert them into whatever `<tr>` it is constructing,
    54	 * interleaving its own cells (e.g. a repository name cell) as needed.
    55	 *
    56	 * @param {Object} opts
    57	 * @param {string}      opts.repoId      - Unique repository identifier.
    58	 * @param {string}      opts.repoName    - Human-readable display name; used in
    59	 *                                         aria-labels. Falls back to `repoId` when
    60	 *                                         the caller has no richer name.
    61	 * @param {Object|null} opts.statusInfo  - GitStatusInfo object from the API, or
    62	 *                                         `null` when no status data is yet available.
    63	 * @param {string}      opts.projectId   - ID of the parent project.
    64	 * @param {string}      opts.wid         - ID of the parent workspace.
    65	 * @param {boolean}    [opts.isStable]   - When `true`, the branch cell is rendered
    66	 *                                         as plain text (no clickable trigger).
    67	 * @param {function(HTMLElement, string, string): void} [opts.onBranchCellClick]
    68	 *                                         Callback invoked with `(anchorEl, repoId,
    69	 *                                         currentBranch)` when the branch trigger is
    70	 *                                         clicked. Only wired when `isStable` is falsy.
    71	 * @param {string|null} [opts.webserverUrl] - Base URL of the local webserver. When
    72	 *                                         truthy, a "Browse" button is inserted
    73	 *                                         before the "Git GUI" button inside
    74	 *                                         `actionsCell`.
    75	 * @returns {{ branchCell: HTMLTableCellElement, badgeCell: HTMLTableCellElement, actionsCell: HTMLTableCellElement }}
    76	 */
    77	export function buildRepoStatusCells({ repoId, repoName, statusInfo, projectId, wid, isStable, onBranchCellClick, webserverUrl }) {
    78	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    79	    // Branch cell
    80	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    81	    const branchCell = document.createElement('td');
    82	    branchCell.className = 'repo-branch-cell';
    83	
    84	    const currentBranch = (statusInfo && statusInfo.currentBranch) ? statusInfo.currentBranch : null;
    85	
    86	    if (!isStable && currentBranch && onBranchCellClick) {
    87	        const trigger = makeBranchTrigger(currentBranch, `Switch branch for ${repoName}`);
    88	        trigger.addEventListener('click', () => onBranchCellClick(trigger, repoId, currentBranch));
    89	        branchCell.appendChild(trigger);
    90	    } else {
    91	        branchCell.textContent = currentBranch || '—';
    92	    }
    93	
    94	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    95	    // Badge cell — wrapper <div> keeps data-repo-id so polling updates can
    96	    // locate and replace badge contents without touching the rest of the row.
    97	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    98	    const badgeCell = document.createElement('td');
    99	    badgeCell.className = 'repo-badge-cell';

101	|---|---|---|
   102	| `get()` | `GET /api/config/polling` | Fetch the current polling interval. Resolves with `{ gitPollingIntervalSeconds: number }`. |
   103	| `set(seconds)` | `PUT /api/config/polling` | Update the polling interval. `seconds` must be a finite integer ≥ 10. Resolves with `{ gitPollingIntervalSeconds: number }`. |
   104	
   105	**Used by:** `settings.js` (`buildRefreshDelaySection()`) to populate the number input on mount and to persist the updated value on save.
   106	
   107	## Reusable Components
   108	
   109	| Component | File | Export | Purpose |
   110	|---|---|---|---|
   111	| Branch Quick Switch | `components/branch-quick-switch.js` | `showBranchQuickSwitch(options): Promise<{ switched: boolean, newBranch?: string }>` | Inline popover anchored below a branch cell. Fetches available branches via `api.branches.list()`, shows a filterable list with a text input, and calls `api.branches.switch()` on confirm. `options`: `{ anchorEl, projectId, wid, repoId, currentBranch }`. Dynamically imported on first click via `import()` to avoid loading for STABLE workspaces. |
   112	| Confirm Dialog | `components/confirm-dialog.js` | `showConfirm(title, message): Promise<void>` | Modal with Cancel/Confirm. Resolves on confirm, rejects on cancel. |
   113	| Form Helpers | `components/form-helpers.js` | `createFormField()`, `validateRequired()`, `WORKSPACE_ID_PATTERN` | Form field generation and validation. |
   114	| Repo Status Cells | `components/repo-status-cells.js` | `buildRepoStatusCells(opts)`, `makeBranchTrigger(branchName, ariaLabel)`, `updateRepoStatusCells(row, repoId, statusInfo, isStable, onBranchCellClick)` | Shared factory for the Branch, Status badge, and Actions `<td>` cells used across repository rows. See [Repo Status Cells Component](#repo-status-cells-component) below. |
   115	| Status Badge | `components/status-badge.js` | `createStatusBadge(gitStatusInfo): HTMLElement` | Git status badge with branch pill and detail chips. |
   116	| Theme Toggle | `components/theme-toggle.js` | `createThemeToggle(): HTMLButtonElement` | Light/dark mode toggle button. Reads/persists theme in `localStorage`. |
   117	| Toast | `components/toast.js` | `showToast(message, type, duration): HTMLElement\|null` | Auto-dismissing notification in `#toast-container`. Message is rendered via `textContent` (not `innerHTML`) — server-controlled strings including git error output are XSS-safe to pass directly. |
   118	
   119	### Repo Status Cells Component
   120	
   121	`components/repo-status-cells.js` encapsulates the reusable Branch, Status badge, and Actions cell-building logic shared between the workspace-detail and repository-detail views. It exports three named functions:
   122	
   123	#### `buildRepoStatusCells(opts)`
   124	
   125	Builds the three shared status `<td>` cells for a single repository row.
   126	
   127	| Option | Type | Required | Description |
   128	|---|---|---|---|
